git_sha_scope: agentrelbench_git_sha values were recorded at run time against the pre-publication development history, which was rewritten before release. They are the true provenance of each batch but do not resolve in the published repository. Any harness comparison below was performed while they still resolved and is recorded here rather than left to be recomputed.
lineage_method: 1 of 1 tasks are uniquely traceable by row content and anchor the model; the remainder are clean-pass cells whose rows are byte-identical across models and were resolved within that model's batches
never_splice: each task traced to exactly one source batch by row content
